title: Fix PlaceBlockGoalDecomposer same-coordinate placements (F29)
description:
## Finding F29 (Council: P1, 93% confidence)

PlaceBlockGoalDecomposer places all blocks at the same coordinates when the blueprint specifies multiple blocks at the same position (e.g., 3 planks at the same x,y,z). The decomposer generates count-driven actions but does not offset subsequent placements or make them distinguishable.

## Effect
A PlaceBlockGoal with count=3 places 3 blocks on top of each other instead of distributing them. Only the first placement succeeds; subsequent ones fail because the space is occupied, wasting dispatches and confusing the evaluation loop.

## Recommendation
In PlaceBlockGoalDecomposer, either:
- Offset subsequent placements by a small amount (e.g., y+1 per placement)
- Make it count-driven (1 action with count=N in args, let adapter handle distribution)
